structured_output.analysis:
The current best is iso_3.15: KL 0.43614 (E514ab09c524e) at 3.14795 average bits, which uses the whole budget. Any per-layer upgrade has to be paid for by a downgrade. The loss is concentrated in MLP layers. The records show large gains from moving those layers up one bit width, for example:
- model.layers.14.mlp.down_proj from rht_gptq_int2 to rht_gptq_int3: 0.00633 to 0.00181 (E4c3f9b73e065, E90bd4b2f3645)
- model.layers.3.mlp.up_proj from rht_gptq_int3 to gptq_int4: 0.00642 to 0.00238 (E6f4f7ea296d5, Ef4ee8cb4969e)

Every downgrade I have records for is far more costly. Moving an int3 layer to int2 adds about 0.02 to 0.03 (Ec2994e80f2d5, E829dc44cee68). I have no per-layer KL records for the cheaper attention layers, so I can't build a measured swap that pays for itself. Changing GPTQ options costs no stored bits, so this round tests option settings only: act_order=true, and act_order=true with damp=0.005.

proposals.name: iso_3.15_actorder
proposals.rationale: This keeps the bits of iso_3.15 (KL 0.43614, E514ab09c524e) and only sets act_order=true for all GPTQ variants, at no bit cost. The loss is concentrated in MLP layers quantized with GPTQ variants, for example model.layers.27.mlp.up_proj with gptq_int3 at 0.00572 (Ef04d8aa7bded) and model.layers.14.mlp.down_proj with rht_gptq_int2 at 0.00633 (E4c3f9b73e065). Their activation kurtosis is high: 1090.09 (E24beed188b6a) and 146.379 (Ef95b39c759fb). act_order=true quantizes the columns with the most activation energy first, which should cut error in layers like these.

proposals.name: iso_3.15_actorder_damp005
proposals.rationale: Same bits as iso_3.15 (KL 0.43614, E514ab09c524e). This sets act_order=true and lowers damp from the default of 0.01 to damp=0.005, so GPTQ follows the calibration Hessian more closely. The target is the dominant GPTQ-quantized MLP layers: model.layers.3.mlp.up_proj with rht_gptq_int3 at 0.00642 (E6f4f7ea296d5) and model.layers.2.mlp.up_proj with gptq_int3 at 0.00642 (E9baa10763ebe).

proposals.name: iso_3.15_rht_actorder
proposals.rationale: Same bits as iso_3.15 (KL 0.43614, E514ab09c524e). This sets act_order=true only for the RHT GPTQ variants, which cover 167 of the 196 cells. Comparing it with the all-variant run separates the effect on the RHT layers, such as model.layers.1.mlp.up_proj with rht_gptq_int3 at 0.00611 (E0564bc6ad1eb) and model.layers.18.mlp.gate_proj with rht_gptq_int2 at 0.00497 (Eb1dd74cd6447).
